title: HAS: Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling for Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.34544v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Due to context-length constraints, most MLLMs cannot process full-length videos and therefore rely on sampling a subset of frames as input. However, existing sampling methods, ranging from uniform sampling to relevance-based selection, are often driven by a single sampling principle and thus struggle to accommodate the heterogeneous evidential requirements of different queries: some demand a holistic understanding of how the video unfolds over time, while others hinge on fine-grained events within a short temporal window. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling (HAS)}, a two-stage frame sampling framework. In the first stage, \emph{Backbone Frame Construction}, we apply a Determinantal Point Process (DPP) to sample frames that are both query-relevant and non-redundant. These selected frames capture key moments across the video and form the backbone of the sampling set, providing a foundation

translated_title: HAS：面向视频理解的分层自适应帧采样
translated_abstract: 由于上下文长度的限制，大多数多模态大语言模型（MLLM）无法处理完整长度的视频，因此依赖对一部分帧进行采样作为输入。然而，现有的采样方法——从均匀采样到基于相关性的选择——通常由单一的采样原则驱动，因而难以适应不同查询的异构证据需求：有些查询需要对视频随时间演变的整体理解，而另一些查询则依赖于短时间窗口内的细粒度事件。为解决这一局限，我们提出了分层自适应帧采样（Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling, HAS），一个两阶段的帧采样框架。在第一阶段“骨干帧构建”中，我们应用行列式点过程来采样既与查询相关又非冗余的帧。这些被选中的帧捕捉了整个视频中的关键时刻，构成采样集的骨干，为其提供一个基础……
tldr: 该论文提出两阶段分层自适应帧采样框架HAS，第一阶段利用行列式点过程（DPP）构建与查询相关且非冗余的骨干帧，以适应不同视频查询从整体时序理解到细粒度事件的异构证据需求。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes HAS, a two-stage hierarchical adaptive frame sampling framework whose first stage employs a Determinantal Point Process (DPP) to construct query-relevant, non-redundant backbone frames, accommodating the heterogeneous evidential requirements of different video queries.
